name: Collaboration Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Collaboration Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow co-authors to chat within a document (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether co-authors can use the chat functionality within an Office application to collaborate with each other when editing a document.

If you enable or don’t configure this policy setting, users can chat with each other when co-authoring a document.

If you disable this policy setting, users can’t chat with each other when co-authoring a document.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus.

properties.name: Default subject for a review request (User)
properties.description: Defines the default subject text for a review request.

properties.name: Default subject for a review request (User)
Do not prompt users to share Excel workbooks when sending for review (User)
properties.description: Checked: Do not prompt the user to share Excel workbooks when sending them for review. | Unchecked: Prompt the user to share Excel workbooks when sending them for review.

properties.name: Max number of documents being reviewed using 'send for review'
Max number of documents being reviewed using 'send for review' (User)
properties.description: Sets the total number of documents that can be sent for review by a user before reusing registry entries from previous review cycles.

properties.name: Max number of documents being reviewed using ad hoc review
Max number of documents being reviewed using ad hoc review (User)
properties.description: Sets the total number of documents that can be sent for review by a user using ad-hoc review before reusing registry entries from previous review cycles.

properties.name: Outlook: 'send for review' (User)
properties.description: "Enable 'send for review"': Enables the Send For Review feature. | "Exclude author's e-mail in documents": Enables the Send For Review feature, but the authors e-mail is not recorded on the sent document. | "Disable 'send for review"': Disables the Send For Review feature.

properties.name: Outlook: Ad hoc reviewing (User)
properties.description: "Enable ad hoc reviewing": Enables the ad-hoc review feature. | "Exclude author's e-mail in documents": Enables the ad-hoc review feature, but the authors e-mail is not recorded on the sent document. | "Disable ad hoc reviewing": Disables the ad-hoc review feature.

properties.name: Prompt for sending reviewed document to author (User)
properties.description: "Never ask user": Do not ask users if they want to send back changes to the author. | "Prompt for 'send for review"': Ask users if they want to send back changes to the author only if the document was sent using Send For Review and not with ad-hoc review. | "Always prompt": Ask users if they want to send back changes to the author for documents sent using either Send For Review or ad-hoc review.

properties.name: When choosing 'Send for Review...' (User)
properties.description: "Send link and attachment": When choosing Send for Review for a document on a server, send both a link and an attachment. | "Only send link": When choosing Send for Review for a document on a server, send only a link. | "Prompt user": When choosing Send for Review for a document on a server, prompt the user for what to send.
